# Chapter 43 – Richer Ground

Scene 1. The new site confirms better, more accessible ice.

Scene 2. The team’s excitement is mixed with dread about what it will take to exploit it.

Scene 3. Processing rigs are deployed.

Scene 4. A thermal fracture event destroys equipment and costs several robots.

Scene 5. Imani chooses to save the data and the surviving crew instead of all the hardware. Bridge: They return not triumphant, but changed.
